passage: Maya planted identical tomato plants on both sides of her yard. The plants on the sunny side produced dozens of tomatoes, while the plants on the shaded side produced only a few. Maya concluded that ______
stem: Which choice most logically completes the text?
choices: the amount of sunlight likely affected how many tomatoes the plants produced.
the plants on the shaded side grew taller because they had more shade.
tomato plants need very little water once they begin producing fruit.
the plants on the shaded side were probably a different tomato variety.
steps: The plants were identical, so a different variety can't explain the result.
The only stated difference is sun versus shade.
The sunny side produced far more tomatoes.
So the logical conclusion is that sunlight affected tomato production.
The text never mentions plant height or water.
key: An inference must follow from the text's facts. Find the one difference that could explain the result.
